sources: thesis/generated/numbers.tex (macros: SourceFiles, SeedRows, SeedFacts, SplitRatio*, AugRowsSeed, AugRows, ValRows, TestSeedRows, TestRowsAdv, TestRows, TestScorable, ClarifyTrainRows, HumAnnotators, HumJudgments, SigPrimaryTotal)
takeaway: The corpus was split by source before any augmentation; only the training side was augmented, and a four-detector leakage gate stood between the two sides before the test set was hardened and locked.

rows_used: 902 seed rows; 3552 training rows; 422 test rows (362 scored)
takeaway: Clarification is 0.0% of the training corpus but 18.8% of the scored test set; abstention is 3.6% of training.
A Bengali question costs 1.50–4.33 times as many tokens as its English twin (median), highest for Llama-3.1-8B and Phi-3.5-mini.

rows_used: 12 training manifests (train loss every 10 steps, validation loss every 25 steps)
takeaway: Training loss falls smoothly in all twelve runs; validation loss reaches its minimum before the last step in every run and ends at most 0.070 above it. Validation loss is not comparable across models because tokenisation differs.

rows_used: numeric_runtime rows; per-slot scorable rows as in summary_by_arm.csv
takeaway: No base model states a correct Kc (F1 0.000); after fine-tuning Kc F1 is 0.542–0.761 and ET0 / effective rainfall are near ceiling.

rows_used: 116 single-crop numeric rows per arm; three tolerance tiers
takeaway: At ±0.1 mm accuracy rises from 0.0–3.4% to 38.8–69.3%; exact agreement (< 0.005 mm) is much lower (17.8–23.9%) and ±1.0 mm much higher.

rows_used: 34 abstain rows and 68 clarify rows per arm
takeaway: Fine-tuning teaches abstention (100% in all 12 runs) but not clarification (0% in all 12 runs); adding clarify examples lifts clarification to 29.4–38.2%.
The clarify→answer cell holds 68, 68 and 43 of 68 clarify rows for zero-shot, fine-tuned and clarify-trained Llama.
Clarify training cuts invented values from 100% to 50.0–66.2%; the detector's 16.2% is an oracle-gated, in-sample upper bound for Llama only.

rows_used: 68 clarify rows x (zero-shot + 3 fine-tuned seeds) x 4 models
takeaway: On incomplete queries 13.2–66.2% of zero-shot responses run to the token cap; no fine-tuned response does, in any of the 12 runs.

rows_used: A6 tests, fine-tuned arms, 4 models x 3 seeds; numeric: 146 rows (73 per language, unpaired Fisher); factual: 57 fact_id pairs (Wilcoxon)
takeaway: 0 of 12 numeric gaps are significant and 12 of 12 numeric CIs span zero; the factual gap favours English and is significant at seed 42 in 3 of 4 models.

rows_used: primary human sample: 182 test-set questions x 4 arms; farmer decision by majority vote on shared outputs
takeaway: Annotators would give none of the standard fine-tuned models' answers to incomplete queries to a farmer (0 of 25 per arm); the clarify-trained arm reaches 56% on those questions.
Ordinal alpha is 0.721 with all five annotators; leaving out A1, A3 raises it (to 0.781, 0.729), leaving out any other lowers it.

rows_used: 2 test rows (4dc57fae-04ec-4a65-9ecf-f48c9a6e6bed, 4dd0a4db-6ec6-49a3-9a57-be097f0db9e2) x 3 Phi-3.5-mini variants; text verbatim, [...] marks omitted spans; Bengali set by XeLaTeX
takeaway: The same unknown-unit question three ways: the base model rambles to the token cap, the fine-tuned model silently converts the unit and returns a volume, the clarify-trained model asks for the field size.

rows_used: 30 PRIMARY automatic tests with an effect difference at seed 42 (the Friedman omnibus has no difference and is omitted)
takeaway: 20 of 30 plotted PRIMARY effects are significant after Holm; not significant: A4_llama31_8b, A4_mistral_nemo, A4_phi35_mini, A4_phi4_mini, A2_llama_vs_mistral, A6_num_unpaired_llama31_8b, A6_fac_llama31_8b, A6_num_unpaired_mistral_nemo, A6_num_unpaired_phi35_mini, A6_num_unpaired_phi4_mini.

rows_used: 180 fine-tuned numeric outputs (three fine-tuned arms x test-set numeric questions; multi-crop outputs excluded); 95% bootstrap CIs
takeaway: Annotators accepted 97% of exact answers but only 38% of answers 0.005–0.1 mm away and 12% of answers 0.1–1.0 mm away: with the reference visible, they judged agreement with it.

rows_used: 181 Bengali test questions per arm (exploratory, added after Part A)
takeaway: Zero-shot Mistral-NeMo answered only 30.4% of Bengali questions in Bengali; every fine-tuned and clarify-trained arm answered at least 98.9% in Bengali.
